name: Site Cuidadores — Afeto (Cloudflare Pages)
start: bash -lc 'rm -f .dev.vars; for v in SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY ASAAS_AMBIENTE ASAAS_API_KEY_PRODUCAO ASAAS_API_KEY_SANDBOX ASAAS_WEBHOOK_TOKEN_PRODUCAO ASAAS_WEBHOOK_TOKEN TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET; do if [ -n "${!v:-}" ]; then printf "%s=%s\n" "$v" "${!v}" >> .dev.vars; fi; done; true'

terminals.name: wrangler pages dev
terminals.description: Serves the static site and Cloudflare Pages Functions at http://localhost:8788. Reads secrets from .dev.vars (generated by the start command from any SUPABASE_*/ASAAS_*/TELEGRAM_* environment secrets).
